cover.lead: Yayasan MENDAKI and NUS High School are partnering to help more Malay/Muslim students pursue their interest in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM).

about.body: Over the next three years, the partnership will help students pursue their studies at NUS High School and give scholarship recipients opportunities to learn from working professionals.

stats.label: scholarships offered every year to Singapore Citizens and PRs enrolled as full-time Year 1 students at NUS High School.
goes to each scholarship recipient to support their studies at NUS High School, made possible by Temasek Foundation.
of MENDAKI and NUS High School working together on scholarships, mentoring and STEM outreach.

journey.caption: After the signing, NUS High School took the MENDAKI team on a tour of its campus.

quote.text: We want our young people who have an interest and aptitude in STEM to have the confidence to explore these fields, pursue their aspirations and see the possibilities ahead of them.
quote.attribution: Mr Feroz Akber, Chief Executive Officer, Yayasan MENDAKI
